node-lens-import.title: Import Photos and Takeout Metadata
node-lens-import.description: Import photos and Takeout metadata, revisit paused imports, and manage import history. Device tests verify that foreground-start recovery survives database recreation and queues a job once without changing its transfer checkpoint. A synthetic import completes with a dismissible notification. Dismissing history survives activity recreation, suppresses late completion notifications, and leaves job records, item records, and source bytes unchanged.

node-lens-preferences.title: Control Library Resource Use and Activity
node-lens-preferences.description: Manage storage budgets, indexing preferences, overnight settings, photo-view preferences, and activity summaries. Review an estimate before clearing downloads, retain the cleanup confirmation across activity recreation, and cancel without changing the tested photo record or media files. A stale estimate is rejected with a request to review the refreshed estimate.
